$comment: The CLE schemas of the TEA OpenAPI spec 0.4.0 (components/schemas: cle, cle-event, cle-event-type, cle-version-specifier, identifier, identifier-type, cle-definitions, cle-support-definition), copied verbatim with $refs pointed at $defs and examples dropped. Used by TeaCleDocumentSchemaTest; refresh on a TEA bump.

cle.description:
Common Lifecycle Enumeration (CLE) object based on ECMA-428 TC54 TG3 CLE Specification v1.0.0.
Contains lifecycle events and optional reusable definitions for a component or product.

events.description:
Ordered array of CLE Event objects representing lifecycle events.
MUST be ordered by ID in descending order (newest events with highest IDs first).

definitions.description: Container for reusable policy definitions referenced by events

cle-event.description: A discrete lifecycle event from the CLE specification

id.description: A unique, auto-incrementing integer identifier for the event

effective.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the event takes effect

published.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the event was first published

version.description: Version string (used by released event type)

versions.description: List of version specifiers affected by this event

supportId.description: Reference to a support policy ID defined in the definitions section

license.description: License identifier (used by released event type)

supersededByVersion.description: Version string that supersedes the affected versions (used by supersededBy event type)

identifiers.description: New identifiers for the component (used by componentRenamed event type)

eventId.description: ID of the event being withdrawn (used by withdrawn event type)

reason.description: Human-readable explanation (used by withdrawn event type)

references.description: List of URLs to supporting documentation

cle-event-type.description: The type of CLE lifecycle event

cle-version-specifier.description: A version specifier that can be either a single version or a version range

range.description: A version range in vers format (e.g. "vers:npm/>=1.0.0|<2.0.0")

identifier.description: An identifier with a specified type

cle-definitions.description: Container for reusable CLE policy definitions

cle-support-definition.description: A support policy definition from CLE

id.description: Unique identifier for the support policy

url.description: URL to detailed documentation about this support policy
